items.q: Will my SEO rankings drop after redesign?
items.a: No — we preserve URL structure, implement 301 redirects for changed paths, retain content and internal links, migrate metadata and schema, and monitor rankings for 90 days post-launch.

items.q: How long does a redesign take?
items.a: Typical dermatology practice redesigns take 5–8 weeks. Multi-location or complex sites take 8–12 weeks. We move on a weekly milestone schedule.

items.q: Do you migrate my existing content?
items.a: Yes. We audit, restructure, and migrate every page — services, providers, before-and-afters, blog, forms, and location data — into the new IA without loss.

items.q: Can you redesign around my current EHR / booking system?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with common dermatology EHRs, patient portals, booking widgets, and CRM tools. HIPAA-aware handling throughout.

items.q: What if I'm mid-contract with my current agency?
items.a: We can start planning during your notice period and go live the day your existing site can be replaced. Zero downtime on launch day.
